name: Android + Perplexity + Mony (CLI only)
install: /bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; /opt/venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && /opt/venv/bin/pip install perplexityai git+https://github.com/Lukafin/mony.git; /opt/venv/bin/python -c "import perplexity, mony; print(\"Deps OK\")"'
start: /bin/bash -lc "/opt/venv/bin/python --version && which /opt/venv/bin/python && /opt/venv/bin/pip --version && /opt/venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; print(\"PY:\", sys.executable); import perplexity, mony; print(\"perplexity OK\", perplexity.__file__); print(\"mony OK\", mony.__file__)' && echo Ready"

terminals.name: Mony CLI
terminals.command: /bin/bash -lc '/opt/venv/bin/python -m mony --help || echo "Mony installed; see README for usage."'
terminals.description: Show Mony CLI help to confirm install.

terminals.name: Perplexity quick check
terminals.command: /bin/bash -lc "/opt/venv/bin/python -c 'import os; print(\"PERPLEXITY_API_KEY set:\", bool(os.environ.get(\"PERPLEXITY_API_KEY\"))); from perplexity import Perplexity; print(\"SDK import OK\")'"
terminals.description: Verifies Perplexity SDK import and that the env var is present.
